response.final_analysis: Vitamin B12, when combined with intrinsic factor, is absorbed in the ileum of the small intestine. This is supported by the presence of specific receptors in the ileum that facilitate the uptake of the Vitamin B12-intrinsic factor complex. Other parts of the gastrointestinal tract do not participate in this specific absorption process.
